Subject: Discovery follow-up: load profile planning & sizing call

Hi Sofia — thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can lock in the dedicated sizing session: 

Summary from today
- Primary objective: understand Nebula Health's peak/APAC/US request patterns and validate a Dedicated GPU pool (throughput/latency tradeoffs).
- Latency target: ~120ms p50 for synchronous inference in production; p95 target discussed as ~420ms (billing/SLAs TBD).
- Expected steady-state throughput: 80–120 reqs/sec, with burst windows up to ~400 reqs/sec for 10–15 minutes during batch jobs.
- Model variant: 13B open checkpoint (quantized), likely with KV-cache reuse across sessions.

What we need before the sizing call
- A small sample load profile (CSV) showing minute-level request counts and average request sizes — this helps us pick batch/worker sizing.
- Any restrictions: e.g., IP allowlists, VPC peering windows, or KMS/HSM requirements for keys.
- List of attendees (engineer + infra + product) so we scope the technical agenda.

Proposed dedicated sizing call (60 minutes) — please pick one: 
- Mon Aug 24, 09:00–10:00 PT
- Tue Aug 25, 13:00–14:00 PT
- Wed Aug 26, 15:00–16:00 PT

I'll bring our throughput playbook, a short checklist, and a rough cost estimate based on the numbers you gave today. I attached our pre-call checklist to this message for quick reference.

Attachments: redwood-precall-checklist.pdf (1 page)

If you can reply with the preferred slot and attach the load-profile CSV, we’ll confirm and send the calendar invite + agenda.

Thanks — looking forward to locking this in.

— Ben
